AND TRUNC(CREATED_DATE) >= TO_DATE(#{search.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(CREATED_DATE) <= TO_DATE(#{search.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND CLID LIKE '%' || #{search.clid} || '%'
AND STATUS = #{search.status}
AND ( UPPER(SUBJECT) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search.keyword} || '%') OR UPPER(MESSAGE) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search.keyword} || '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT ID, CLID, SUBJECT, MESSAGE, SEND_DATE, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_DATE, RETRY_COUNT, HAS_FOLLOW_UP, FOLLOW_UP_COUNT, LAST_CALL_DATE, LAST_CALL_RESULT FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RN, T.* FROM ( SELECT L.ID, L.CLID, L.SUBJECT, L.MESSAGE, L.CREATED_DATE AS SEND_DATE, L.STATUS, L.ERROR_MESSAGE, L.CREATED_DATE, L.RETRY_COUNT, 0 AS HAS_FOLLOW_UP, 0 AS FOLLOW_UP_COUNT, NULL AS LAST_CALL_DATE, NULL AS LAST_CALL_RESULT FROM LMS_LOG L
ORDER BY L.CREATED_DATE DESC, L.ID DESC ) T WHERE ROWNUM <= #{search.endRow} ) WHERE RN > #{search.startRow}
SELECT ID, CLID, SUBJECT, MESSAGE, SEND_DATE, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_DATE, RETRY_COUNT FROM LMS_LOG WHERE ID = #{id}

SELECT C.CALLDATE, C.CLID, C.PERSON_CODE, C.CUST_CODE, C.PROJECT_CODE, C.RESULT, C.EMPNO, C.INCALL_NO, C.CONTEXT, C.CONFIRM, C.REGID, NULL AS EMP_NAME, NULL AS AGENT_NAME, TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CALL_DATETIME FROM CALL_LOG_D C INNER JOIN LMS_LOG L ON C.CLID = L.CLID WHERE L.ID = #{lmsId} AND C.CUST_CODE = 'P000000179' AND TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= L.CREATED_DATE AND TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= L.CREATED_DATE + INTERVAL '1' DAY ORDER BY TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC

SELECT C.CALLDATE, C.CLID, C.PERSON_CODE, C.CUST_CODE, C.PROJECT_CODE, C.RESULT, C.EMPNO, C.INCALL_NO, C.CONTEXT, C.CONFIRM, C.REGID, NULL AS EMP_NAME, NULL AS AGENT_NAME, TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CALL_DATETIME FROM CALL_LOG_D C WHERE C.CLID = #{clid} AND C.CUST_CODE = #{custCode} AND TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_DATE(#{sendDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= TO_DATE(#{sendDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1' DAY ORDER BY TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_SENT, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.LMS_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS RECONTACTED, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.HAS_SUCCESS = 1 THEN 1 END) AS CALL_SUCCESS FROM LMS_LOG L LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L2.ID as LMS_ID, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN C2.RESULT LIKE '%완료%' OR C2.RESULT LIKE '%성공%' OR C2.RESULT = 'ANSWER' THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_SUCCESS FROM LMS_LOG L2 INNER JOIN CALL_LOG_D C2 ON L2.CLID = C2.CLID AND C2.CUST_CODE = #{search.custCode} AND TO_DATE(C2.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') > L2.CREATED_DATE AND TO_DATE(C2.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= L2.CREATED_DATE + INTERVAL '7' DAY GROUP BY L2.ID ) C ON L.ID = C.LMS_ID

SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM L.CREATED_DATE) BETWEEN 8 AND 11 THEN 'MORNING' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM L.CREATED_DATE) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'AFTERNOON' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM L.CREATED_DATE) BETWEEN 18 AND 21 THEN 'EVENING' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS TIME_SLOT, COUNT(*) AS SENT, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.LMS_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS RECONTACTED FROM LMS_LOG L LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L2.ID as LMS_ID FROM LMS_LOG L2 INNER JOIN CALL_LOG_D C2 ON L2.CLID = C2.CLID AND C2.CUST_CODE = #{search.custCode} AND TO_DATE(C2.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') > L2.CREATED_DATE AND TO_DATE(C2.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= L2.CREATED_DATE + INTERVAL '7' DAY GROUP BY L2.ID ) C ON L.ID = C.LMS_ID
GROUP BY CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM L.CREATED_DATE) BETWEEN 8 AND 11 THEN 'MORNING' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM L.CREATED_DATE) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'AFTERNOON' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM L.CREATED_DATE) BETWEEN 18 AND 21 THEN 'EVENING' ELSE 'OTHER' END ORDER BY TIME_SLOT

SELECT C.EMPNO AS AGENT_NAME, C.EMPNO, COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS SENT, COUNT(DISTINCT C.CLID) AS RECONTACTED, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.RESULT LIKE '%완료%' OR C.RESULT LIKE '%성공%' THEN 1 END) AS CALL_SUCCESS FROM LMS_LOG L INNER JOIN CALL_LOG_D C ON L.CLID = C.CLID AND TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= L.CREATED_DATE AND TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= L.CREATED_DATE + INTERVAL '1' DAY WHERE C.CUST_CODE = #{search.custCode}
AND TRUNC(L.CREATED_DATE) >= TO_DATE(#{search.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(L.CREATED_DATE) <= TO_DATE(#{search.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY C.EMPNO HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) > 0 ORDER BY RECONTACTED DESC, CALL_SUCCESS DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEND_DATE, COUNT(*) AS SENT, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.LMS_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS RECONTACTED, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.HAS_SUCCESS = 1 THEN 1 END) AS CALL_SUCCESS FROM LMS_LOG L LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L2.ID as LMS_ID, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN C2.RESULT LIKE '%완료%' OR C2.RESULT LIKE '%성공%' OR C2.RESULT = 'ANSWER' THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_SUCCESS FROM LMS_LOG L2 INNER JOIN CALL_LOG_D C2 ON L2.CLID = C2.CLID AND C2.CUST_CODE = #{search.custCode} AND TO_DATE(C2.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') > L2.CREATED_DATE AND TO_DATE(C2.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= L2.CREATED_DATE + INTERVAL '7' DAY GROUP BY L2.ID ) C ON L.ID = C.LMS_ID
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 7

SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%상담%' OR UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%문의%' THEN '상담 요청' WHEN UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%재상담%' OR UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%재문의%' THEN '재상담 안내' WHEN UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%완료%' OR UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%감사%' THEN '상담 완료' ELSE '기타' END AS MESSAGE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS SENT, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.LMS_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS RECONTACTED FROM LMS_LOG L LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L2.ID as LMS_ID FROM LMS_LOG L2 INNER JOIN CALL_LOG_D C2 ON L2.CLID = C2.CLID AND C2.CUST_CODE = #{search.custCode} AND TO_DATE(C2.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') > L2.CREATED_DATE AND TO_DATE(C2.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= L2.CREATED_DATE + INTERVAL '7' DAY GROUP BY L2.ID ) C ON L.ID = C.LMS_ID
GROUP BY CASE WHEN UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%상담%' OR UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%문의%' THEN '상담 요청' WHEN UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%재상담%' OR UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%재문의%' THEN '재상담 안내' WHEN UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%완료%' OR UPPER(L.SUBJECT) LIKE '%감사%' THEN '상담 완료' ELSE '기타' END ORDER BY SENT DESC

SELECT ROUND( NVL(AVG( EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - L.CREATED_DATE)) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - L.CREATED_DATE)) ), 0), 2 ) AS AVG_RESPONSE_TIME FROM LMS_LOG L INNER JOIN CALL_LOG_D C ON L.CLID = C.CLID AND TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') > L.CREATED_DATE AND TRUNC(TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) = TRUNC(L.CREATED_DATE)

WITH LMS_WITH_FOLLOWUP AS ( SELECT /*+ USE_INDEX(L, PK_LMS_LOG) USE_INDEX(C, IDX_CALL_LOG_CLID_DATE) */ L.ID, L.CLID, L.CREATED_DATE, L.SEND_DATE, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM L.CREATED_DATE) AS HOUR_SENT, -- 후속 통화 여부 (조건 완화 - CUST_CODE 조건 제거, 기간 확장) CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CALL_LOG_D C WHERE C.CLID = L.CLID AND C.CALLDATE >= TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND C.CALLDATE <= TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_DATE + INTERVAL '30' DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_FOLLOWUP, -- 성공 통화 여부 (ANSWER를 통화완료로 인정) CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CALL_LOG_D C WHERE C.CLID = L.CLID AND C.CALLDATE >= TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND C.CALLDATE <= TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_DATE + INTERVAL '30' DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND (C.RESULT = 'ANSWER' OR C.RESULT LIKE '%완료%' OR C.RESULT LIKE '%성공%') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_SUCCESS, -- 평균 응답시간 계산 (분 단위, 당일 재연락 기준만) (SELECT ROUND(AVG( EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - L.CREATED_DATE)) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - L.CREATED_DATE)) ), 2) FROM CALL_LOG_D C WHERE C.CLID = L.CLID AND C.CALLDATE >= TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TRUNC(TO_DATE(C.CALLDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) = TRUNC(L.CREATED_DATE) ) AS RESPONSE_TIME_MINUTES FROM LMS_LOG L
) SELECT -- 기본 통계 COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_SENT, SUM(HAS_FOLLOWUP) AS RECONTACTED, ROUND((SUM(HAS_FOLLOWUP) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 1) AS RECONTACT_RATE, SUM(HAS_SUCCESS) AS CALL_SUCCESS, ROUND((SUM(HAS_SUCCESS) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(HAS_FOLLOWUP), 0)), 1) AS CALL_SUCCESS_RATE,
-- 평균 응답시간 (분 단위, 소수점 2자리) ROUND(AVG(RESPONSE_TIME_MINUTES), 2) AS AVG_RESPONSE_TIME,
-- 시간대별 통계 SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR_SENT BETWEEN 8 AND 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MORNING_SENT, SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR_SENT BETWEEN 8 AND 11 AND HAS_FOLLOWUP = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MORNING_RECONTACTED, SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR_SENT BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AFTERNOON_SENT, SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR_SENT BETWEEN 12 AND 17 AND HAS_FOLLOWUP = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AFTERNOON_RECONTACTED, SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR_SENT BETWEEN 18 AND 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EVENING_SENT, SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR_SENT BETWEEN 18 AND 21 AND HAS_FOLLOWUP = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EVENING_RECONTACTED,
-- 추가 통계 (현재는 기본값) 0 AS CONSULT_REQUEST_SENT, 0 AS CONSULT_REQUEST_RECONTACTED, 0 AS RECONSULT_SENT, 0 AS RECONSULT_RECONTACTED, 0 AS COMPLETE_SENT, 0 AS COMPLETE_RECONTACTED, 0 AS OTHER_SENT, 0 AS OTHER_RECONTACTED, 'SYSTEM' AS TOP_AGENT, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TODAY_DATE, SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(CREATED_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TODAY_SENT, SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(CREATED_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND HAS_FOLLOWUP = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TODAY_RECONTACTED FROM LMS_WITH_FOLLOWUP
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'LMS_LOG'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CALL_LOG_D'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LMS_LOG) AS LMS_LOG_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CALL_LOG_D WHERE CUST_CODE = #{custCode}) AS CALL_LOG_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CALL_LOG_D WHERE CUST_CODE = #{custCode} AND CALLDATE IS NOT NULL) AS VALID_CALL_LOG_COUNT FROM DUAL
